description: This file contains accounting and financial transaction logic including sales, expenses, petty cash, and journal postings for a multi-tenant accounting platform. It defines functions for creating sales, expenses, petty cash entries, bulk operations, and related journal entries, utilizing PostgreSQL for persistence.

methods.name: nextSequential(tenantId, code, client = null)
methods.description: Generates a sequential number for a given sequence code, ensuring atomic increment in the sequences table.

methods.name: computeTax(amount, taxConfig)
methods.description: Calculates net, tax, and gross amounts based on amount and tax configuration, handling inclusive and exclusive tax scenarios.

methods.name: validatePayments(total, payments)
methods.description: Validates that total payment amounts match the expected total.

methods.name: getRealtimeBalances(tenantId, { account_ids } = {})
methods.description: Fetches account balances for specified accounts, aggregating ledger entries.

methods.name: postJournal(tenantId, client, { date, narration, lines,  source_table, source_id, voucher_prefix = 'VCHR', })
methods.description: Inserts a balanced journal entry with multiple ledger lines, linked to a source transaction.

methods.name: recordSales(tenantId, user, payload)
methods.description: Creates a sales transaction, calculates taxes, generates receipt number, posts journal, and links voucher number.

methods.name: recordExpense(tenantId, user, payload)
methods.description: Records an expense, computes taxes, posts journal, and links voucher number.

methods.name: recordPettyCash(tenantId, user, payload)
methods.description: Manages petty cash top-up and expense transactions, with journal posting.

methods.name: bulkSales(tenantId, user, salesArray = [])
methods.description: Performs bulk creation of sales transactions atomically with individual journal entries.

methods.name: bulkExpenses(tenantId, user, expensesArray = [])
methods.description: Performs bulk creation of expense transactions atomically.

methods.name: validateTransaction(payload)
methods.description: Performs basic validation of transaction payloads.

ctags.name: postJournal
ctags.signature: (tenantId, client, { date, narration, lines,  source_table, source_id, voucher_prefix = 'VCHR', })
